candidate_program.name: bottleneck_gap_pressure
candidate_program.rationale: Combines a saturated duration benefit based on the larger resource gap with count and weighted conflict pressure. Reach covers root attributes and its neighborhood; arithmetic is constant cost, with ordinary conflict-summary update costs retained.
candidate_program.rule: weight * (1 + duration / (1 + duration + max(station_gap, satellite_gap))) / (1 + degree + 0.5 * conflict_weight / (1 + max_conflict_weight))

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
